summary: The RODEL 26-27 was conducted on 28th September virtually at 8 pm.
description: The RODEL 26-27 was conducted on 28th September virtually at 8 pm. The debate topic was, "Brics is now a formidable alternative to top global Organisations"The debate was between Rotary club of Sher-E- Punjab versus Rotary Club of Addiction Prevention and both the clubs did very well. From RCAP, Rtn Dr Trupti Pai, Rtn Vijay Cavale and Rtn Manpreet Nagi participated. The overall debate wenton very sportively and the For team RCAP had strong points to support the topic. RCAP won the Debate and looks forward to the next round.
